storyTitle: [API] [Roster] Rosters: require birth date, add Graduation Year, keep player ids on re-upload, remove USA Lacrosse #

testCases.description: Check that the feature meets this requirement: A roster file with a row that has no athlete birth date, or a birth date that is not a real date, is rejected. The message names the row and the field. No rows from that file are saved. Manual add without an athlete birth date is rejected. Player self-registration asks for the athlete birth date and requires it. The downloaded default template has an "Athlete Graduation Year" column and no "USA Lacrosse #" column. Custom templates have "Athlete Graduation Year" selected by default and "USA Lacrosse #" not selected. A graduation year that is not a 4-digit year is rejected with the row named. A blank graduation year is accepted. GET /tournament/team/rosters/:teamId returns the graduation year for each player that has one. A team uploads a roster, then uploads it again with Replace: every player with the same first name, last name and birth date keeps the same id. A new player gets a new id. A player not in the new file is removed. The same id rule works for Add uploads and for the organizer's upload. A template file downloaded before this change (with "USA Lacrosse #", without "Athlete Graduation Year") still uploads with no column error. Tested on dev, then released to production.
Check that a required date cannot be left empty.
